a) the use of a UAS for the acquisition of RGB imagery is a suitable method to derive yield prediction maps for corn, b) the use of CSMs for the determination of crop heights is beneficial for the prediction of corn yield, c) the combination of spectral and spatial information is a promising method for yield prediction, but d) the prediction ability is still limited by the low spatial resolution of the CSMs and the low number of observations.
